trans-unit.resname: Transaction speed
Determines the transaction fee that we recommend to the customer.
trans-unit.source: Determines the transaction fee that we recommend to the customer.
trans-unit.target: Determina la commissione di rete consigliata al cliente.

trans-unit.resname: Order before payment
Order after payment
Order creation method
Will we create the order as soon as the user gets redirect to BTCPay Server or do we wait for the webhook.
trans-unit.source: Will we create the order as soon as the user gets redirect to BTCPay Server or do we wait for the webhook.
trans-unit.target: Indica se l'ordine viene creato appena il cliente viene mandato a BTCPay Server oppure solo quando arriva la notifica (webhook) di pagamento.

trans-unit.resname: Protect order status

Will protect the order status from changing to "failed" if it already has a "paid" order state. This will protect an order from being cancelled via webhook, if it was paid via a different payment gateway.
trans-unit.source: Will protect the order status from changing to "failed" if it already has a "paid" order state. This will protect an order from being cancelled via webhook, if it was paid via a different payment gateway.
trans-unit.target: Impedisce che un ordine già in uno stato "pagato" passi a "non riuscito". Così un ordine pagato con un altro metodo non viene annullato da una notifica (webhook).

To be able to use this payment module you need to have a BTCPay Server instance, either self-hosted or hosted by a third-party.
trans-unit.source: To be able to use this payment module you need to have a BTCPay Server instance, either self-hosted or hosted by a third-party.
trans-unit.target: Per usare questo modulo serve un'istanza BTCPay Server, installata in proprio oppure ospitata da terzi.

trans-unit.resname: Furthermore, you must have a registered account on the instance, an actual store on the instance and a wallet connected to your store.
trans-unit.source: Furthermore, you must have a registered account on the instance, an actual store on the instance and a wallet connected to your store.

trans-unit.resname: Setup information

The quickest way to get the plugin working is to set the proper BTCPay Server URL and press save. You will be redirected to your BTCPay Server where you will be guided through the API key creation process. Once the key is created, you'll be redirected back to PrestaShop.
trans-unit.source: The quickest way to get the plugin working is to set the proper BTCPay Server URL and press save. You will be redirected to your BTCPay Server where you will be guided through the API key creation process. Once the key is created, you'll be redirected back to PrestaShop.
trans-unit.target: Il modo più rapido per attivare il modulo è inserire l'indirizzo di BTCPay Server e salvare. Verrai mandato al tuo BTCPay Server, che ti guiderà nella creazione della chiave API; poi tornerai su PrestaShop.

trans-unit.resname: Redirecting back from BTCPay Server sometimes fails due to PrestaShop weirdness. If it does, you can still use this plugin by copying the API key from /account/apikeys and pasting it in the form.
trans-unit.source: Redirecting back from BTCPay Server sometimes fails due to PrestaShop weirdness. If it does, you can still use this plugin by copying the API key from /account/apikeys and pasting it in the form.
trans-unit.target: A volte il ritorno da BTCPay Server a PrestaShop non riesce. In quel caso copia la chiave API da /account/apikeys e incollala nel modulo.

trans-unit.resname: If preferred, you can also make an API key yourself by pressing the button below (make sure your BTCPay Server URL is correct, first) or by creating it at /account/addapikey. If you are going to make an API key yourself, make sure that it has the following permissions for a singular store:
